notes: [P1] design gap: src/game.js starts the next wave as soon as wave N has spawned out and the board is clear, and createWave gives it timer 0, so wave N+1's first ghost spawns on the very next step. Issue #2 gives a breather between waves as its reason, but its What and the acceptance criterion never ask for a gap between waves, so this is not an outcome miss. Adding an inter-wave delay would be a good follow-up.

[P1] missing test: nothing checks the drawGhost health bar in src/render.js. A stubbed-ctx test that records each fillRect width and fillStyle would cover the length and colour at full health, at 2/3 and at 1/3. Today a regression in the Board artboard bar would pass CI.

[P2] edge: healthFraction in src/enemy.js divides health by maxHealth without a guard. createEnemy({ health: 0 }) gives NaN, which drawHealthBar then passes to fillRect as a width. No caller does this today.

[P2] fragile test: test/game.test.js 'the wave number moves from 1 to 2 only when the lanterns banish the last ghost of wave 1' depends on lanterns at cells (0,1), (1,1) and (0,3) all being in range of the spawn point on the current WAYPOINTS. Changing the path would break it for reasons that have nothing to do with waves.
